title: Define versioned planning lifecycle architecture
description: Implement and freeze the cross-cutting contract for a second planning lifecycle after the grouping and reusable queues complete. Define fixed planning statuses toplan, researched, planned, and rejected; the .wtp/planning/<status> layout; reuse of the global UUID and branch-scoped short-ID allocator; preservation of the complete task metadata payload; nil execution lifecycle timestamps; revisable transitions; separate provider query surfaces; the planning CLI family; project/version/milestone report shape; AND grouping filters across issueId, project, milestone, version, featureId, and feature; dependency-closed promotion; dedicated journal ordering after batch and reusable recovery; and canonical export layout. Keep normal task stats, batch workflows, graphs, and claims planning-blind. Add foundational types/interfaces plus compile-time and architecture contract tests so dependent tasks make no policy decisions. Explicitly exclude planning deletion, comments, batch editing, execution-graph expansion, and non-flat-file support.
